items.detail: The **Nasdaq** fell 2.1% to 26,140.03 Friday and the S&P 500 lost 1.1% to 7,659.44, capping the Nasdaq's worst week since June, down 4.5%.
items.why: Chipmakers led the slide, with Micron and Intel down nearly 6%, as doubts about AI spending returned.

items.detail: AI-focused software stocks lost about **$260 billion** in value and Palantir entered a correction, as CoreWeave's bond yields climbed above 15%.
items.why: Goldman Sachs warned about debt-funded AI building, and CoreWeave's roughly $50 billion of debt became the focus.

items.detail: Futures-implied odds of an October Fed hike fell to about **15%** from 27%, with the 10-year yield little changed near 5.08%.
items.why: Fed Chair Warsh refused to signal his next move, which traders read as a likely October pause.

items.detail: The **MSCI Emerging Markets** index rose 0.8% Friday but was still headed for its steepest weekly drop since March.
items.why: Samsung and SK Hynix bounced, but four losing sessions on AI-spending doubts dominated the week.

items.detail: The **Sensex** rose 414 points to 74,729.27 Friday, a second straight gain, and the Nifty closed at 23,146.15 as the IT index jumped about 4%.
items.why: Wipro and Tech Mahindra beat revenue forecasts in their September-quarter results, lifting the whole IT sector.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** fell 1.66% to 2,721.37 Friday, erasing Thursday's bounce and ending the week down about 3%.
items.why: The AI and tech selloff spread to smaller companies, and yields near 5.1% kept borrowing costs high.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** held near **$81,500** early Saturday, barely moving after Friday's 2.1% Nasdaq drop.
items.why: Warsh's refusal to signal a rate hike steadied buyers even as tech stocks sold off.

items.detail: **Ether** briefly dropped below $2,400 Friday and traded around **$2,409** Saturday.
items.why: US spot ether ETFs lost $69.7 million Friday, a third straight day of outflows, all from BlackRock's ETHA.

items.detail: **Solana** hovered near **$104**, just above $100, three days before Tuesday's Alpenglow upgrade.
items.why: US Solana ETFs have had nine straight days of outflows, which is outweighing excitement about the upgrade.

items.detail: **Gold** gave up Thursday's push toward $4,200 and ended the week near **$4,167**, down about 0.5%.
items.why: Treasury yields near 5.1% outweighed fading bets on an October Fed hike, capping gold's rebound.

crossCuttingTheme: Fear over debt-funded AI spending, centered on CoreWeave, set off a selloff in chip and software stocks that hit the Nasdaq, small caps and Asian chipmakers, while Warsh's refusal to signal a hike steadied bitcoin.
